generated_by: Designed in Milestone 6 from the evidence in docs/production/taxonomy-product-review.md and milestone-06.md: the discovered taxonomy's assignment counts and platform spread, its own 450-review evaluation (27.6% unclassified, smallest category 1 review), description-embedding confusability, and the business themes the discovered set never covered.
notes: The customer-facing product taxonomy. Broad, industry-neutral themes a business would recognise, replacing single-vertical research artefacts such as Salon Service Failures and Mirror Performance Failures. The research taxonomy 1.1.0 is NOT deleted: it stays packaged as default_categories.json, its rows stay in the categories table so historical analysis still resolves, and it remains loadable through core.taxonomy.load_dissertation_taxonomy(). 'key' is the stable identity and must never be regenerated when a display name changes. There is deliberately no catch-all 'Other' category: the categoriser's 0.35 confidence threshold already yields 'Unclassified / Emerging Complaint', and an Other bucket would absorb weak matches and destroy that emerging-issue signal.

changelog.change: Packaged the 24 BERTopic-discovered categories as product reference data (Milestone 5A).
Added stable machine-readable keys; no names, descriptions or exemplars changed (Milestone 5B).

New designed product taxonomy of 13 industry-neutral categories (Milestone 6). The 1.1.0 research taxonomy is retained, not replaced in place; historical results keep resolving to their original category rows.

exemplars: stopped working after two weeks
the food was cold and tasteless
poor build quality for the price
